test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Granny said to Nina, "I don't know why I think it is so wonderful."

options.text: Granny said to Nina that she doesn't know why she thinks it was so wonderful.
Granny told Nina that she didn't know why she thought it was so wonderful.
Granny said to Nina that she hadn't known why she was thinking it was so wonderful.
Granny said to Nina that I don't know why you think it is so wonderful

solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'Granny told Nina that she didn't know why she thought it was so wonderful.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'said to' will be changed into 'told' because reporting verb has an object, Nina.'
 
• The indirect speech will begin like **'**Granny told Nina that.'
 
• Now we have to change the reported speech.
 
• Here 'I' is used twice and will be changed into 'she' twice.
 
• Here, **'**don't know why' is in simple present tense and will be changed into simple past i.e., **'**didn't know why.'
 
• Also, **'**think' will be changed into 'thought.'
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'Granny told Nina that she didn't know why she thought it was so wonderful.'
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Granny told Nina that she didn't know why she thought it was so wonderful.*
